q.x: Related: If you haven't seen this 60 year old US Navy training video on "mechanical fire control computers" it is definitely worth a watch. [link]

desc: A 1953 training film for a mechanical fire control computer aboard Navy Ships.  Amazing how problems of mathematical computation were solved so elegantly in "permanent" mechanical form, before microprocessors became inexpensive and commonplace.
